note: Theme catalog. Screen 2a shows the ownership states; 4a/4b show the two new themes. Ownership is NOT part of a theme definition — a theme is an audio-visual package; entitlement is account/device state. Kept in one file here only so the handoff shows both together.
inheritanceRule: Every theme is materialized at startup by merging its overrides over the base (Neon). At runtime every lookup hits a complete theme; there is no per-lookup fallback.

locked.rowTreatment: preview tile at 45% opacity, name #b2b6ca, description #75798c
locked.buttonStyle: accent outline 2px #9184d9, radius 11, padding 9px 13px, 14px, padlock icon + price

storeRequirements: A 'Restore purchases' affordance must be present wherever paid content is listed.
Prices must be read from the store SDK at runtime, localized — never hardcoded. The $1.99 above is mock data.
A locked theme must still render its preview; buying is the only gate.
failureBehavior: If a theme fails to load, show a modal saying the theme is unavailable and asking the player to pick another, then fall back to Neon. See Theming.md.
